name: maturity
description: A local, branch-less dependency updater with a safety release delay.

scripts.build: tsc && VERSION=$(node -e "import fs from 'fs'; console.log(JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('./package.json')).version)") && sed -i '' "s/__VERSION__/$VERSION/g" dist/index.js && echo '#!/usr/bin/env node' | cat - dist/index.js > dist/index.tmp.js && mv dist/index.tmp.js dist/index.js && chmod +x dist/index.js

author: Florian Bartels-Oks (atkuva GmbH)
